sentences.text: Guillaume Emmanuel `` Guy-Manuel '' de Homem-Christo -LRB- -LSB- ɡi manɥɛl də ɔmɛm kʁisto -RSB- ; born 8 February 1974 -RRB- is a French musician , record producer , singer , songwriter , DJ and film director , best known for being one half of the French house music duo Daft Punk , along with Thomas Bangalter .	Daft Punk	Daft Punk	French house music	French house	Thomas Bangalter	Thomas Bangalter
He has also produced several works from his record label Crydamoure with label co-owner Éric Chedeville .	Crydamoure	Crydamoure
He and Chedeville formed the musical duo Le Knight Club .
